partly_completed.note: Partly completed machinery: no CE marking, declaration of incorporation and assembly instructions

R8.title: MR cybersecurity requirements

requirements.text: Connecting another device or remote device must not lead to a hazardous situation
Hardware components transmitting signals or data relevant to safety are protected against accidental or intentional corruption
Software and data critical for compliance are identified and protected against accidental or intentional corruption
Evidence of legitimate or illegitimate intervention in that software or in its configuration is collected
Control systems withstand intended operating stresses and intended and unintended external influences, including reasonably foreseeable malicious attempts by third parties
Tracing logs of interventions on the safety-related software and of changes to it, kept for 5 years after upload
Safety-related control system limits are not exceeded by malicious actions

R8.certification_presumption: Certification or statement of conformity under a European cybersecurity scheme (Regulation (EU) 2019/881) gives presumption of conformity for 1.1.9 and 1.2.1 as far as covered (MR Art. 20(9))
R8.verify_note: Exact wording of 1.1.9 and 1.2.1 points and of Art. 20(9) to verify on EUR-Lex (W3)
